search.title: Search
search.subtitle: Find any moment in your videos.
search.placeholder: Search actions, objects, sounds and logos
search.search_by_entity: Paste an image as a visual entity to search by
search.hint_group_by: `clip` returns shot-level hits; `video` returns one hit per video.
search.no_matches: No matches. Try a different phrasing or upload more videos in

ground.title: Ground
ground.subtitle: Locate the exact moment in a video that matches your text query.
ground.placeholder: Describe the moment you're looking for
ground.hint: Uses InternVideo2 features with a trained SG-DETR head (visual), falling back to CG-DETR or QD-DETR-CLAP for audio-only inputs. Returns exact (start, end) moments sorted by score.
ground.unsupported: Ground is not available for this video (modality: {{modality}}).

analyze.title: Analyze
analyze.subtitle: Generate summaries, chapters, highlights, and more insights.
analyze.placeholder: Type in a prompt or select a suggested prompt. e.g., Summarize the video and provide timecodes
analyze.restrict_range: Restrict to a specific time range
analyze.unsupported: This video has no usable visual or audio content for the Analyze tile (modality: {{modality}}).

highlights.title: Highlights
highlights.subtitle: Auto-pick the top moments — no query required.
highlights.hint: Runs the SG-DETR saliency head on InternVideo2 features with a generic 'key moment' prompt. Top-10 spans returned.
highlights.example_auto_reel_title: Auto-pick top moments for a highlight reel
highlights.example_auto_reel_note: SG-DETR saliency picks the most interesting clips with no query needed.
highlights.example_trailer_note: Top 10 saliency peaks. Use the moment spans below to cut a reel.

moderate.title: Moderate
moderate.subtitle: Specialised classifier scores per shot — NSFW (visual) + toxicity (text).
moderate.hint: Falconsai NSFW ViT for frames, unitary/toxic-bert for ASR. Scores in [0,1]; threshold gates the flagged list.
moderate.hint_threshold: Flag a shot when max(nsfw, toxic) >= threshold.
moderate.no_flags: No shots crossed the threshold ({{threshold}}). Highest scores: NSFW {{nsfw}}, Toxic {{toxic}}.

recommend.title: Recommend
recommend.subtitle: Find videos in your library most similar to a seed video.
recommend.hint: Cosine similarity over mean-pooled caption embeddings. No new model required.
recommend.no_similar: No similar videos in your library yet. Upload more videos in Library.
recommend.no_similar_toast: No similar videos yet — upload more to your library.
recommend.example_topic_note: Pick any seed video; results are ranked by mean-pooled caption-embedding cosine in your library.
recommend.example_library_note: Best used after you've uploaded 3+ videos of varied topics.

segment.title: Segment
segment.empty_state: Pick a video and hit Segment to see the multi-track timeline + metadata.
segment.save_title: Save current definition as a preset
segment.attach_title: Attach a reference image (visual hint for the segmenter)
segment.image_attached: Image attached — will be sent with the segment definition.
segment.fix_json_first: Fix the JSON before saving a preset.
segment.pick_label: Pick a label for the saved preset.
segment.copy_url_error: Pick a video first to copy its URL.
segment.clipboard_blocked: Clipboard blocked — copy manually from the player.
segment.no_segments: No segments produced — the selected definitions have no implemented segmenter yet.
segment.image_too_large: Image too large — keep it under 4MB.

sounds.title: Sounds
sounds.subtitle: Find shots by audio event — laughter, applause, music, alarms, and 523 more.
sounds.hint: PANN CNN14 tagged each shot with top-5 AudioSet labels at ingest. Search is a case-insensitive substring match.
sounds.hint_tag: AudioSet label substring (e.g. Laughter, Music). Leave blank to list all shots.
sounds.no_matches: No shots match{{tag}}. Try a different tag, or re-ingest the video if audio tags weren't computed.

library.title: Library
library.subtitle: Upload videos to make them searchable. Indexing runs automatically — videos appear here once they're ready.
